name: Card Exchange Rate 1
definition: Further detailed information on the exchange rate that has been used in or is related to the transaction.

Provider.name: Provider
Provider.definition: Identifies the source of the rate information.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the specific rate, table or file that contains the rate information.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: The date the exchange rate data is effective.

Time.name: Time
Time.definition: The time the exchange rate data is effective.

EndPoint.name: End Point
EndPoint.definition: Identifies the party to which this detail applies. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

CounterCurrencyCode.name: Counter Currency Code
CounterCurrencyCode.definition: Identifies the counter currency used for currency conversion for the transaction party.

BaseCurrencyCode.name: Base Currency Code
BaseCurrencyCode.definition: Identifies the base currency used for currency conversion for the transaction party.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Identifies the type of rate. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

AgreementType.name: Agreement Type
AgreementType.definition: Type of exchange rate agreement. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

RateLockRequested.name: Rate Lock Requested
RateLockRequested.definition: Indicates if a rate lock is or was requested.

RateLockEligible.name: Rate Lock Eligible
RateLockEligible.definition: Indicates if the transaction is rate lock eligible.

RateLockApplied.name: Rate Lock Applied
RateLockApplied.definition: Indicates if a rate lock was applied.
